title: Moho with Claude and Love2D?
author: ipreuss
selftext:
I’m currently developing a match-3 RPG in LÖVE2D, and graphics are—as usual—one of the things I struggle with.

There’s currently a Humble Bundle featuring Moho. I’d never heard of it before, but it looks interesting.   
Apparently, it supports Lua scripting, and there’s already an MCP server for the newer versions, which makes me wonder whether it could work well in an AI-assisted game-dev workflow.

Does anyone here have experience with Moho, particularly for game development or in combination with AI coding tools? How useful is it in practice?

Just to be clear: I’m in no way affiliated with Moho or the bundle. I genuinely have no idea whether it’s any good for this use case—that’s why I’m asking.
